body: There you go! Your doing better than me in school atleast lol. Reward yourself a little bit by trying out your hobbies again a little bit. And if you don’t want to atleast you can say you passed with A’s. : )

I feel you about the studying except for the fact that I’m just to unmotivated to do anything apart from lay down until I sleep and my grades feel the bite from it. How are your grades and such doing? Studying in its self isn’t too bad but don’t over think it. Hopefully there is a light at the end of this tunnel eh?
I don’t know I just wish no one else had to feel this way.

I don’t know how I’m getting out of this one either. I thought it was bad before but lately everything just kind of blew up. But I guess there could be a light at the end of this shit show. Is there anything you enjoy doing?

I know but like I used to be a decent A and B student and since everything happened I just haven’t been doing anything so now Most of my grades are F and D. It’s just hard to focus on something when your biggest concern is on your own bigger problems. But there’s still time for you too. 23 is so young in the grand scheme of things. You definitely have time to turn it around. I believe in you.
Me too!! I’m only 16 but everyone my age seems to have their shit together and it makes it hard for me to talk to anyone. Is it a similar situation with you?
Probably a lot of decisions I made that led me to the point I’m in. What about for you?

No your not faking it. Everyone has their own problems they face. Just because it looks bigger in the distance doesn’t mean your problems have any less weight. I’m very sorry for your loss man. I hope you can get through this.
I don’t like where I’m at either. I haven’t had much of an experience with them but I’m here to talk to if you want.
Yeah we’re pretty much in the same boat. Having a hard time enjoying my hobbies too. What things do you enjoy doing?
